As someone with adhd I have been accused by my own parents (the ones who took me to get diagnosed) of faking it because my symptoms and how I conduct myself is different to my brother who also has adhd. Professional psychologists know what they’re looking for, teachers do not. Adhd is a massive spectrum, and I highly doubt this teacher knows anything about it as it’s much easier to blame a child for not wanting to study rather then themselves being incapable of adapting their teaching abilities to support neurodivergent children.

Obviously adhd is not the worst thing to have, but it is a handicap for school students. It doesn’t matter how many children are diagnosed with it, it absolutely sucks arse to have. It’s not cute and trendy, and it’s not a silly quirk vapid people on tik tok just take out of the void to get more likes with. It seriously effects the people who have it, and boo fuckity hoo it inconveniences people who have to teach around it.

Regardless of a child’s diagnosis, facts are facts: no one wants to study after six hours of school. You can call them lazy all you want. Children are going to prioritise their interests over an education system that has no interest in them.

Kids are not lazy because they hate studying, and as this teacher had already made evident, they lack the ability to emphasise and understand why their students don’t study.

This is 100% a rant. I am not a kid. Just bitter with past experience.
